design_principles: Quality and structural coverage over raw repetition.
Explicit clarification when required information is absent.
Informal but understandable conversational language is valid.
Context facts must be used when present and not invented when absent.
High-stakes prompts receive a short safe boundary or escalation.
DPO negatives isolate concrete failure modes.
Existing evaluation splits remain sealed from training.
dpo_sampling: Exactly 50% of every new SFT class.
